sections.title: Executive Summary
paragraphs: Redbean is a revolutionary single-file web server that embeds Lua, SQLite, and MbedTLS into a single executable binary.
It allows developers to create hermetic web applications that run natively on six different operating systems without any external dependencies.

sections.title: Value Proposition
bullets: Zero-dependency deployment: No need to manage complex server environments.
Universal Portability: One file runs everywhere (Windows, Linux, macOS).
Embedded Database: SQLite integration for instant data persistence.
Scriptable Logic: Lua provides a lightweight and powerful scripting layer.

sections.title: Monetization Strategies
paragraphs: 1. Starter Kits: Create and sell pre-configured Redbean templates for specific use cases (e.g., personal dashboards, internal tools) on Gumroad.
2. Redbean-as-a-Service: Deploy micro-tools that use Redbean as the backbone, offering a 'no-infrastructure' backend for clients.
3. White-labeling: Offer custom internal tools for enterprises that require high portability and security.

sections.title: Landing Page Structure
bullets: Hero: Build & Ship Web Apps in a Single File.
Features: No Dependencies, Native OS Support, Embedded SQLite, Lua Scripting.
